mistakes.text: Her friend asked why she refused their jacket.
mistakes.normalized: her friend asked why she refused their jacket
mistakes.kind: Past Simple instead of Past Perfect
mistakes.feedback_sk: Odmietnutie bolo pred otázkou, preto je lepší Past Perfect: „had refused“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Odmítnutí bylo před otázkou, proto je lepší Past Perfect: „had refused“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The refusal came before the question, so the Past Perfect “had refused” is better.

mistakes.feedback_en: After past “asked”, move the tense back: “she had refused”, not “has refused”.
